behaviour_changes: The required secret-scan job's unittest step is stricter; the job's YAML is unchanged. Its fixture tests error on a scan error, where exit status 1 with a partial report could let a test that expects no findings pass.
On a host with the guarded launcher, 'could not acquire the per-user lock' (an exit status other than 75) is now an error, not a skip. A busy lock still skips.

The busy-lock skip no longer fires on any stderr that merely contains "lock" (the old test). A scan that completed with such a stderr line, for example a git message that gitleaks v8.30.1 forwards from its git source (sources/git.go lines 251-264: listed benign messages as warnings, every other line as an error), used to skip and is now checked.
